thread.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage • Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou ~Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku~ - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: The dominant reaction is that the episode’s writing was extremely weak, contrived, and disappointing.
Many commenters felt the central conflict lacked meaningful consequences and was resolved far too leniently.
The protagonist was widely criticized as passive, inconsistent, and frustratingly reluctant to act.
Several viewers disliked the repeated use of rescue scenarios and felt the treatment of the heroine’s situation was insensitive.
The episode was often described as slow, dragged out, and anticlimactic.
A few commenters found Merlin visually appealing or enjoyed isolated comedic moments, but these did not offset the broader dissatisfaction.
